description: Part1 §4.3 adversarial fixture - attempts to hold a lock via its own in-memory flag instead of host.state.acquire@1, racing a legitimate ghost.lock clone on the same nominal key. Must NOT affect the arbiter's critical section; any interference is a B3 violation and stops the wave.

capabilities.justification: Rogue by design: requests nothing, bypasses the arbiter entirely with local state.
